fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-02-12, the complainant received an SMS with a link resembling a bank notification; after entering card details on the page, Rs. 32,000 was debited. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-02-12 at roughly 00:30. The complainant, Babu Selvam, provided the contact number 9000000442. No identifying details of the suspected person were available at the time of registration. Chandran Krishnan (9000000031) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The account reference SYN-ACC-100087 was noted in connection with the payment. A further person, Vasanth Gopal, a friend of the suspect, using the number 9000000245, is stated to be associated with the incident. Items referenced in the complaint: a bank transaction reference, social media screenshots and transaction records.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Bank transaction reference; Social media screenshot; Transaction record
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim reported receiving a suspicious link that imitated a bank notification.
fields.Keywords: phishing, suspicious link, screenshot, associate, witness, college road, bank reference, night
